name: Jodoora
source:
Darklaw is the High Inquisitor of Labyrinthia, where she works to rid the town of witches. She is also the only person normally able to meet directly with the town's "creator", the mysterious Storyteller.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Darklaw]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
